Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement path & marketplace interest — Redwood Inference next steps

Hi Devin / Priya — great to meet on the call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can align on procurement and the commercial path.

Recap from today
- AtlasData is interested in Redwood for low-latency inference (batch + streaming) for analytics features.
- Primary preference: keep options open between direct contract (PO) and AWS Marketplace listing.
- Procurement timeline: targeting contract execution in Q2; budget owned by Platform team.

Questions we had for procurement readiness
1) Preferred purchase mechanism: company card, PO + invoice, or AWS Marketplace?
2) Do you require an MSA + SOW or do you prefer our standard SaaS order form?
3) Any required legal/security artifacts (SOC2 report, DPA) that procurement needs up front?

Suggested next steps
- If PO: I can share a short SaaS order form and a standard MSA for redlines. (attached: Redwood-Marketplace-Options.pdf)
- If Marketplace: I can loop in Partnerships to scope listing requirements and expected lead time.
- Procurement kickoff: propose a 30-min call next week to align on process and timelines.

Attachments: Redwood-Marketplace-Options.pdf (one-pager on PO vs AWS/GCP marketplace paths, stub)

If you can confirm preferred purchase path and the procurement contact (if different from Priya), I’ll send the right artifacts and schedule the kickoff.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — good talk. Short answers:
- Procurement preference: PO + invoice right now. We centralize vendor payment via PO.
- Marketplace: we'd prefer AWS Marketplace long term (entitlements, consolidated billing) but understand it can take extra lead time and setup.
- Legal: we'll need MSA with a few redlines around data residency and indemnity. SOC 2 Type II and DPA will be required for security review.

Timeline: budget approval expected by end of April, target contract signed by mid-May if reviews go smoothly.

Priya (cc) is our procurement lead — she’ll coordinate PO steps.

- Devin

- PO path is typically faster for initial piloting — we can issue invoices on 30-day terms and later migrate to Marketplace for production if desired.

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear options. A few notes from procurement:
- We will proceed with PO + invoice for the pilot. Our AP team issues POs and requires an invoice that references the PO number.
- Preferred payment terms: Net 30.
- We typically sign an MSA + SOW; please send a standard MSA and a redline-friendly SOW.
- Marketplace: helpful for later consolidation, but it does add complexity for us today (catalog setup + entitlements). We’d prefer PO now and revisit Marketplace post-pilot.

Documents we need now
1) Pricing sheet that maps to SKUs or seat/usage metrics — Pricing-Sheet.xlsx (please include list prices and any pilot discount)
2) Standard MSA and SaaS order form
3) Invoicing instructions and remit address

I’ve attached our internal PO instructions (PO-Instructions.pdf) that include what our AP team needs on invoices. Once we receive the order form and MSA, we’ll generate a PO and send it over.

Thanks —
